title.rendered: Free Medical Outreach in Aboh Mbaise LGA

content.rendered: oin HopeRising for Imolites for a two-day free medical outreach event in Aboh Mbaise LGA, Imo State. Our team, led by founder Barr. Obioma Success Akagburuonye, will provide essential medical and surgical care, as well as distribute palliatives to support those in need during these challenging times. This initiative is the first of many, with plans to extend to all 27 LGAs of Imo State. Don’t miss this opportunity for free healthcare services and community support!
